the US Treasury says lawful users may use mixers for privacy
summary_en: VitalikButerin added the strawmap proposal to replace the two round Casper FFG finality gadget with Minimmit. AndyGuzmanEth cited the US Treasury saying lawful users may use mixers for financial privacy on public blockchains. chunter-cb clarified EIP-8130 naming and k1 behavior, submitted and merged.
